layer8FunctionApproximator.causality: output step s uses the query point at s and only knots/values from generated NF states <=s

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared module reused at every matching block; layers other than 8 remain GNGLUs, while layer 8 is one shared causal knot-basis function unit
architecture.outputState: layer 7 maps PF to NF; layer 8 derives normalized points, knots, raw derivative-of-Gaussian weights w=b, and knot values from the causal generated NF prefix; layer 2 decodes W to 17 primitive coordinates; differentiable code reconstructs the complete future production59 state
architecture.baseConsistency: BTC one-second candle geometry, return activity, aggregate trade flow, aggressor side, spot volume, completed futures-minute state, and ETH minute return are decoded once; every affected production channel is derived from the same predicted primitive history

loss.description: 50% standardized two-step return MSE, 25% standardized MSE over the other 58 derived channels, and 25% standardized direct primitive-coordinate MSE; minute coordinates are supervised only at minute completion

sampling.description: the exact original production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population
sampling.comparisonControl: identical samples, K1/K2, widths, projections, balanced data loss, optimizer, batches, and EMA as the explicit-whitening predecessor; only explicit Gram inverse-square-root whitening is removed and replaced by a weight-1 Gram-identity auxiliary loss while inference uses raw w=b

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.comparableMetrics: step-1 and per-step return metrics remain directly comparable to the explicit-whitening predecessor

alignment.input: two consecutive production59 rows ending at each control origin
alignment.target: two complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.causalDerivation: only predicted primitive coordinates and observed history through the origin enter changing future channels; predicted step 1 updates rolling state before step 2
alignment.functionBasisCausality: the step-s point is evaluated only against knots and values from generated NF states at steps <=s; Gram statistics are estimated per causal prefix from unpadded current-batch examples
